description: Displays an SVG map with region selection, tooltips, panning, and zooming.

props.baseColor: Fill color for shapes without a fill in the SVG. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.baseStroke: Stroke color for shapes without a stroke in the SVG. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.color: Fill color of selected regions. Accepts a theme color or CSS color.
props.disablePan: Disables dragging, `Shift` + arrow key panning, and moving the view to reveal focused regions or regions passed to `reveal`.
props.disableZoom: Disables double click, pinch, and wheel zoom, and the exposed zoom methods.
props.disabled: Disables region selection, tooltips, and map navigation.
props.highlighted: Region identifier, or array of identifiers, shown with the hover overlay. Supports `v-model:highlighted`, which also reports the region under the pointer or keyboard focus.
props.label: Accessible name of the map. Accepts plain text or a locale key. Recommended, since the map has no visible name.
props.mandatory: Prevents deselecting the last selected region.
props.maxZoom: Maximum magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox.
props.minZoom: Minimum magnification. Values below one are treated as one.
props.modelValue: Selected region identifier, or an array of identifiers when **multiple** is enabled. Activating a selected region deselects it, unless **mandatory** keeps it.
props.multiple: Allows selecting more than one region. The model contains an array of region identifiers.
props.readonly: Prevents selection changes while keeping navigation and the `click:region` event.
props.regions: Extra data per region, keyed by region identifier. `title` replaces the SVG label and `color` the fill. All fields reach the slots and the `click:region` event.
props.svg: SVG markup supplied by the application. Parsing runs after mounting in the browser.
props.wheelZoom: Zooms with the plain mouse wheel. `Ctrl` or `⌘` with the wheel, and trackpad pinch, zoom regardless.
props.zoom: Magnification relative to the complete SVG viewBox. Supports `v-model:zoom`.
props.zoomOnFocus: Fits a keyboard-focused region in the viewport, within the zoom limits. With **disable-zoom** it only pans, and with **disable-pan** it does nothing. Respects reduced motion preferences.
props.zoomStep: Relative zoom increment used by the mouse wheel, double click, and exposed zoom methods. Also adjusts the sensitivity of continuous pinch zoom.

slots.default: Content inside the map container, outside SVG. Receives the regions, selection, current `zoom` and its limits, and `setZoom`, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `resetZoom`, and `reveal` functions for custom controls.
slots.error: Content shown when SVG parsing fails. Receives the error.
slots.map: Additional SVG content positioned in the source map coordinate system. Receives the regions, including fields from **regions**, the selection, and the current viewBox.
slots.tooltip: Custom tooltip content. Receives the `region`, including fields from **regions**, and its selection state.

events.click:region: Emitted with the originating mouse or keyboard event and `{ region }` when a region is activated.
events.error: Emitted when parsing the SVG fails.
events.load: Emitted with the regions found in the SVG after it has been parsed.
events.update:highlighted: Emitted with the region identifier under the pointer or keyboard focus, or null when it leaves.
events.update:zoom: Emitted when a navigation action changes magnification.

exposed.resetZoom: Restores centered framing at the minimum zoom.
exposed.reveal: Pans to show one region or a group of regions by identifier. `{ zoom: true }` fits them in the view and `{ zoom: false }` only pans; without it, **zoom-on-focus** decides. Keyboard focus stays where it is.
exposed.zoomIn: Increases zoom around the center of the current view.
exposed.zoomOut: Decreases zoom around the center of the current view.
